comment: Copy this file to `config.json` and edit for your local setup. `incoming_data` is the path to the directory of input data, as provided - e.g. `~/data/argentina-transport/C Incoming Data/`. `data` is the path to the directory of working data, input/output by these scripts. `figures` is the path to output figures. `results` is the path to derived results output by these scripts. `osm_snapshot` is the date of the OpenStreetMap planet file to build the Africa extract from, as yymmdd. Planet files are cut on Mondays, so it has to be a Monday.
